notes.title: Version 1.2 Release
notes.notes:
Even when Japanese is selected in the language settings, Simplified Chinese and Korean can now also be chosen from Config.

Fixed an issue where Auto mode and Skip mode would stop during certain scenes.

Corrected typos, misspellings, and furigana.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Release
notes.notes: Fix the issue that the ending cut scene is not shown correclty in specific environments including SteamDeck.
